description: Retyping a complete formula with empty free support as a sentence preserves its truth under every free-variable assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.sentenceOfNoFreeVar_realize.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u'} [DecidableEq α] (φ : L.Formula α)
  (h : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.freeVarFinset φ = ∅) (a : α → M) :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.sentenceOfNoFreeVar φ h ↔ φ.Realize a
